name: nanobanana
tagline_zh: 要海报、Logo、信息图？它自动把提示词喂给 Gemini 3 Pro Image，文字像印刷一样清楚。改图。
tagline_en: Posters, logos, infographics? It auto-tunes prompts for Gemini 3 Pro Image so text renders print-sharp. Edit.
desc_en: Generate or edit photorealistic images with perfect text rendering using Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image). Automatically enhances prompts for this reasoning-based model and supports aspect ratio, resolution, and reference-image editing. Use when users ask to create or edit images, logos, infographics, posters, diagrams, wallpapers, or any visual content.
why_zh: 普通文生图模型把文字当噪声，它专为推理型图像模型做提示词增强，让模型先想清楚每个字怎么写，再落笔。
why_en: Most image models treat text as noise. This one preps prompts for a reasoning-based model, so it plans each glyph before.
limit_zh: 只认 Nano Banana Pro（Gemini 3 Pro Image）这一种后端。
limit_en: Requires Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) backend—won't work with other models. Output is image files only; no editable PSD or vector layers.
title_en: Nano Banana Pro images with crisp, correct text
